items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I think Orrin Keepnews produced some of this stuff, didn’t he?

ctx.x: You know in these days when we used to do these albums it would be like — first I would get there and Bobby would have nothing together. And we’d get there and rehearse the tunes and maybe we’d do it like in two days at the most. At the most. It’s unbelievable how fast we used to do those. But we were playing all the time though.
Yeah. I think Orrin Keepnews produced some of this stuff, didn’t he?
